v4.9.071 - a sync does not choose your view (#342)

Every pull called autoPhoneMainView - the "what should this project open in"
rule. On a landscape project that forces 3x2. So a sync marched the user back
to the grid no matter where they were or what they had open, and the photo just
taken appeared to jump away.

It was always wrong and merely rare, because a pull used to happen seldom.
#320 made a pull follow every push and then it was constant.

Opening a project still chooses the view. A sync no longer does.
